# Changelog {.unnumbered}

Databases grow, websites get redesigned, and accession versions rise. Check
here to find out whether the copy you are holding is the current one.

The current version is printed on the title page and in the filename of the
PDF. Releases are at `github.com/rikhinkavuru/NoLabRequired/releases`.

## Version 1.0

First release.

Every externally-sourced number in this edition was checked against its live
source during production. The dataset index records the date for each one.

### Known limitations

- The differential expression analysis in Part 4 uses a t-test on log counts.
  That is chosen so the reader can follow every step with what Chapters 11 to
  21 taught them. It is not what a working analyst would run, and Chapter 25
  says so and names what is used instead.
- Descriptions of other people's websites carry the date they were checked.
  They will drift. Where a description has gone stale, the invariant the
  chapter names should still hold, and an issue on the repository is the
  fastest way to get the text corrected.
- The book covers no command-line software. Chapter 1 states what that costs
  the reader.
